## Overview

This page will introduce Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation, describe the general
logic of an FPVS experiment, and distinguish the method from related visual EEG
approaches.

## Why use FPVS?

This section will explain the kinds of research questions FPVS can address and
the practical characteristics that make the method useful.

## The basic measurement

This section will connect a periodic stimulus sequence to the frequency-tagged
response measured in EEG data. An annotated overview figure will be added here.

## What this guide covers

The remaining pages will move from foundational concepts to experiment design,
data processing, response quantification, interpretation, and reporting.
